subject: Draft case study: Manufactura + Redwood — passback and quote approval
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@manufactura.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft case study: Manufactura + Redwood — passback and quote approval

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. We've pulled together a short case study draft that highlights the production results your team saw after migrating inference to Redwood. The attached (manufactura-case-draft-v1.docx) is the first-pass — lightweight, customer-forward, and built for a 1-page highlight.

Key asks for review:
- Please confirm the two metrics called out on page 1: a p99 latency reduction from ~320ms to ~95ms, and a 3.1x reduction in inference cost per 1M tokens (we flagged your internal estimate).
- Approve or edit the proposed quote by Diego Alvarez (we used the line below).
- Confirm the job title and preferred name for the byline (we have "Diego Alvarez, Head of ML Ops").
- Any compliance/marketing constraints (e.g., logo usage, product naming) we should be aware of.

Target timeline: if possible we'd love sign-off by Monday 2026-11-09 to get the case queued for a Nov 12 publish. If you need more time, tell us a date that works.

Attachment: manufactura-case-draft-v1.docx (one-page draft)

Thanks — we kept the language conservative but approachable.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi | Sr. Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@manufactura.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sandra Legal <sandra.legal@manufactura.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft case study: Manufactura + Redwood — passback and quote approval

Irene —

Thanks for sending this over. We like the framing, a few quick notes inline and attached (manufactura-redlines-1.docx):
- The latency numbers look right but please change the phrasing from "p99 latency" to "tail latency (approx. p99)" — we don't publish strict pXX metrics without an internal audit.
- For the cost claim, can we soften "3.1x reduction" to "~3x reduction"? Our finance team prefers rounded figures in external communications.
- Please remove the sentence that implies on-prem deployment; we only moved inference to the cloud in this engagement.
- Quote edit: Diego would prefer: "Redwood gave us predictable inference at scale and cut our per-request cost by roughly threefold, enabling more interactive product experiences."

Sandra in legal is cc'd; she'll confirm any compliance language. We can sign off once the minor edits and the billing snapshot are included (I'll attach a CSV of the three-month billing summary).

Publishing timeline — Nov 12 should work for us but we need the final draft by Nov 9 for internal approvals.

Best,
Alex
Alex Moreno | VP of Product, Manufactura

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@manufactura.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft case study: Manufactura + Redwood — passback and quote approval

Alex —

Appreciate the quick pass and the specific edits. I'll make the wording changes you suggested (tail latency phrasing; soften to "~3x"; remove the on-prem reference) and update the quote to Diego's preferred line.

Marissa — can you confirm Marketing is OK with the softened metric and the revised quote? Jasmine, can you flag anything from CS about name/title or logo use?

I'll send a v2 with the redlines incorporated and attach the new draft back to this thread.

Attachment: manufactura-case-draft-v2.docx

Thanks —
Irene

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:31:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft case study: Manufactura + Redwood — passback and quote approval

Looping in a quick marketing sign-off. A few editorial notes:
- The revised quote from Alex is great; let's use Diego's approved text exactly to avoid back-and-forth.
- On the metric: we can accept "~3x" on the hero line, but marketing needs a verifiable source listed in the metadata (either a billing snapshot or a product telemetry export). Can Alex supply that? We should not publish the numeric claim without the backup.
- Please avoid use of the full product codename in marketing copy; use "Redwood Inference" or "Redwood" only.

Irene — once the CSV is attached and we've got Diego's final byline confirmation, I'm happy to greenlight for Nov 12. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/78412 — please attach the signed approval to the deal record.

—Marissa
Director, Content Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@manufactura.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft case study: Manufactura + Redwood — passback and quote approval

Hey all —

Attached is a three-month billing snapshot (billing-snapshot-Nov.csv) that backs the cost delta in the case study. I've anonymized invoice IDs and left only the aggregate totals and per-request cost metrics.

Diego confirms his byline as: "Diego Alvarez, Head of ML Ops" and approves the final quote below for publication: 

"Redwood gave us predictable inference at scale and cut our per-request cost by roughly threefold, enabling more interactive product experiences."

Sandra (legal) has reviewed and is comfortable with the conservative phrasing (cc'd earlier). You have my sign-off to publish Nov 12. Please remove the on-prem language as discussed.

Thanks for working through this — happy to be a customer quote.

Best,
Alex

Attachment: billing-snapshot-Nov.csv

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>

Alex / team —

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround and the billing snapshot. Confirming:
- We will publish the case study on Nov 12 as requested.
- Final hero metric will read "~3x reduction in inference cost per 1M tokens" with a reference in the metadata to the attached CSV.
- Quote and byline are set exactly as Diego provided.

Marissa/Jasmine — I'll upload the final PDF and the signed approval to the HubSpot deal and schedule the publish. Jasmine, can CS please send the logo usage permission to marketing?

Forwarding Alex's sign-off below for the record.
